conventions.refusals: code 99 ('Refused'/'No answer') is EXCLUDED from every mean and every distribution; its unweighted count and its unweighted+weighted share are reported per cell (n_refused, refused_share_unweighted, refused_share_weighted). Race refusal in W42 F_RACETHN is code 9, not 99.
conventions.weights: every mean/distribution is weighted by the wave weight named in waves.<w>.weight; unweighted n reported alongside as n_unweighted_valid
conventions.se: linearised SE of a weighted ratio mean: sqrt(sum w_i^2 (x_i-xbar)^2)/sum w_i. No PSU/strata variables are distributed with these files, so this ignores any clustering; it does capture the weight variation (see kish_effective_n).
conventions.kish_effective_n: (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 on the valid cases in the cell
conventions.dist_*: proportions over the item's substantive response options, among valid (non-refused) cases

party3_with_leaners.derivation: recoded from F_PARTYSUM_FINAL (Pew's own leaner-collapsed variable): 1=Rep/Lean Rep, 2=Dem/Lean Dem, 9->3=no lean/DK/Ref

within_person_referent_shift_w42_form1.description: W42 Form 1 respondents rated MEDICAL, ENVIRONMENTAL and NUTRITION research scientists on the SAME item battery, so environmental-minus-medical is a WITHIN-PERSON, weighted, randomisation-free contrast (item order randomised by Pew across the three groups). Positive = environmental research scientists rated HIGHER (more trust) than medical research scientists.
within_person_referent_shift_w42_form1.filter: FORM_W42 == 1; each contrast uses respondents valid (non-99, non-missing) on BOTH items

RQ1.item_text_pattern: view of the group overall (mostly positive / neither / mostly negative)

RQ2.item_text_pattern: how much respondent knows about what they do

RQ4A.item_text_pattern: Do a good job conducting research

RQ4B.item_text_pattern: Provide fair and accurate information when making statements about their research

RQ4C.item_text_pattern: Admit mistakes and take responsibility for them

RQ4D.item_text_pattern: Are transparent about potential conflicts of interest with industry groups

RQ4E.item_text_pattern: Care about the best interests of the public

RQ5.item_text_pattern: research misconduct by this group is a problem (reversed: higher = less of a problem)

RQ6.item_text_pattern: news stories about misconduct are isolated incidents (100) vs signs of a broader problem (0)

RQ7.item_text_pattern: scientists have good intentions/system broken (100) vs scientists are the problem (0)

RQ8.item_text_pattern: this group faces serious consequences for misconduct

RQ4_A_to_E_composite.definition: unweighted mean of the five RQ4 items' 0-100 scores, listwise complete on all five

between_form_medical_vs_generic_confiden.description: 'Medical scientists' and 'Scientists' are two randomly-assigned FORMS of the same confidence item, so medical-minus-generic is an independent-samples randomised contrast within each wave. Positive = MEDICAL scientists get more confidence than plain 'scientists'.
between_form_medical_vs_generic_confiden.se_note: SE = sqrt(se_med^2 + se_sci^2); the two form samples are disjoint

chained_environmental_vs_generic_referen.formula: (environmental - medical, within-person, RQ4 A-E composite) MINUS (medical - generic 'scientists', between-form, CONF item) = implied (environmental research scientists - 'scientists'), in pp of 0-100 scale range
chained_environmental_vs_generic_referen.assumption: THE TWO LEGS USE DIFFERENT ITEMS (RQ4 5-item battery vs the single CONF item). The chain assumes a referent contrast expressed in pp of scale range transfers between those two 4-point formats. Treat as an order-of-magnitude bridge, not a point estimate.
